LanguageData.MT_InstallLocalUnavailable: Stock is present on this map but is currently unavailable because of forbidden status, reservations or access on its floor.
LanguageData.MT_InstallOtherMapOnly: Stock is on another map. Bring it to this map, then refresh the list.
LanguageData.MT_InstallCatalogRefresh: Base items are always listed. Grades and stock on other loaded maps update when opening or refreshing this list. Parts on another floor of this map can be selected; installation waits until a worker can haul them through connected stairs or ladders.
